content: {"paper_id":"W2077989172","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Constrained clustering aims to exploit this prior belief as constraint (or weak supervision) to influence the cluster formation so as to obtain a data structure more closely resembling human perception.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以成对 must-link/cannot-link 先验约束作为有限监督信息指导全部样本聚类，符合半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Two important issues remain open: 1) how to exploit sparse constraints effectively and 2) how to handle ill-conditioned/noisy constraints generated by imperfect oracles.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将稀疏及不完美来源产生的 noisy constraints 作为弱监督信号，并作为核心问题处理，符合弱监督学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"Specifically, in contrast to existing constrained clustering approaches that blindly rely on all features for constraint propagation, our approach searches for neighborhoods driven by discriminative feature selection for more effective constraint diffusion.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"针对稀疏成对约束，用特征选择搜索邻域进行约束传播/扩散，符合成对约束传播。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","reason_zh":"摘要提到成对相似度度量与约束扩散，但未明确学习或修正样本间边、邻接或亲和矩阵，故不足以判定图结构学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
